feedback.sentBody: Your feedback was sent and stored for the admins.
feedback.errorEmpty: Please choose a recipient and a category and enter a message.

admin.title: Admin Panel
admin.confirmDeleteGroup: Delete this group including all messages?
admin.imprintHint: Formatting: “# ” starts a new section with a heading, “- ” a bullet line, blank lines separate paragraphs. Changes take effect immediately for all users.
admin.desktopOnly: The Admin Panel is available on desktop only — on tablets and phones the administration would be too cramped. Please open it on a computer.
admin.logbookHint: The same calculation as in “my AAA Logbook”: completed forms plus manual entries, including the instructors' corrections and deletions. The “Other Training” column also covers free-text categories.
admin.userGroupsHint: Every person must belong to at least one group. Groups control chat access and Instructor Info visibility.
admin.emailLoginHint: The email address is the only sign-in credential — sign-in is by email only.
admin.permMatrixHint: The superadmin always has every permission. This matrix defines what the Admin and Training Admin roles are allowed to do. What belongs to the individual person — grading, trainee, directory, chat block — is below under “People”. Changes take effect immediately.

perm.grading_create: Fill in and send grading forms
perm.info_manage: Create and manage Instructor Info entries
perm.contacts_manage: Edit the Who to call directory

admin.lastGroupBlocked: Every user must belong to at least one group — otherwise they lose access to chats and group-scoped Instructor Info. Assign a different group first.
admin.aircraftTypesGlobal: Aircraft types (all forms and lesson plans)
admin.autoSaveHint: All changes in the Admin Panel are saved immediately — there is no save button.
admin.documentHeader: Print header of the training forms
admin.documentHeaderHint: Appears in the header and footer of every printed form and PDF.
admin.deactivateHint: Deactivated users keep their history and can no longer sign in. Records, messages and signatures stay attributable — that is why accounts are never deleted.
admin.emailTaken: This email address is already assigned to another user. It is the only sign-in identifier and has to stay unique.
admin.groupNameTaken: A group with this name already exists.
admin.noAccess: You do not have access to the Admin Panel.
admin.noUsersMatch: No user matches the current filters.
admin.storageHint: Data is stored on this device (IndexedDB). The bar shows how much of the browser-allotted space is in use; a warning banner appears app-wide above 85 %.
admin.storageUnknown: This browser does not report storage usage.

import.title: Import users from a table
import.intro: Download the template, fill it in with Excel, save it as “CSV UTF-8” and upload it here. You will see every row before anything is created. There are no passwords: people sign in with their email address and a 6-digit code, so the address decides — it must use an allowed domain.
import.headerError: The header row does not match. It must contain at least Name, Email and Role — use the template.
import.p_emailDomain: Domain not allowed — this person could never sign in
import.p_emailDuplicate: Email appears twice in the file
import.p_role: Role unknown (superadmin, admin, training admin, member)
import.templateHint: The same template as in Users → Import users. Fill it in with Excel, save it as “CSV UTF-8” and upload it under Users.
import.p_aircraftMissing: No aircraft type — this person would see no lesson plans, info entries or chats

bulk.noChange: Nothing to change — the selection is already set that way
bulk.skippedSelf: Your own account was skipped — otherwise you would lock yourself out.
bulk.skippedLastSuper: The last active superadmin was skipped — otherwise nobody could reach the admin area.
bulk.roleNote: Role stays a single-user decision: a slip there would hit every selected account at once.
bulk.skippedHidden: {{count}} users were skipped — they were not in the list shown.
bulk.skippedLastAircraft: Not applied to {{count}} person(s): it would have been their last aircraft type. Those roles would then see no lesson plans, no instructor info and no type-specific chats.

admin.aircraftTypesHint: Controls which lesson plans, info entries and chats this person sees. At least one type.
admin.aircraftTypesFree: This role sees every type anyway. An assignment is possible but does not limit what they see.
admin.lastAircraftBlocked: The last aircraft type cannot be removed: this role would then see no lesson plans, no instructor info and no type-specific chats. Assign another type first.
admin.permPeopleHint: These four permissions belong to the individual person, not to their role. They used to sit inside the expanded user row — here they stand side by side for everyone, so they can be compared. Changes take effect immediately.
admin.permElsewhereHint: Two things are permissions as well, but they belong with their subject rather than here — listing them here too would mean maintaining them twice.
admin.permElsewhereUsers: Role and aircraft type assignment belong to a user’s identity.
admin.permElsewhereGroups: Who administers a chat is decided at that chat.
